name: waterplane
description: waterplane — phone-native remote control for Claude Code on your PC
author: Johannes Hoh

scripts.build:shared: node scripts/need-deps.mjs && node scripts/fix-node-pty.mjs && npm run build -w @waterplane/shared
scripts.dev: node scripts/oswrap.mjs dev -- npm run dev:posix
scripts.dev:posix: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n host,web -c blue,green "npm:dev:host" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @waterplane/host && npm run build -w @waterplane/web && npm run build:ext-assets
scripts.start: node scripts/oswrap.mjs start -- npm run start -w @waterplane/host
scripts.doctor: node scripts/oswrap.mjs doctor -- npm run doctor:posix --
scripts.doctor:posix: npm run build:shared --silent && npm run build -w @waterplane/host --silent && node packages/host/dist/main.js --doctor
scripts.test:unit: npm run build:shared && npm run test:unit:only
scripts.audit: npm run audit:prod && npm audit --audit-level=high && npm audit --audit-level=high --prefix packages/app
scripts.test:host: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @waterplane/host && npm run test:host:only
scripts.test:contract: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @waterplane/host && node scripts/run-contract.mjs
scripts.media: node scripts/ui/run.mjs --media; s=$?; node scripts/media/flow-svg.mjs && node scripts/media/flow-gif.mjs && node scripts/site/build-site.mjs && exit $s
scripts.test: npm run lint && npm run test:unit && npm run test:host && node scripts/run-e2e.mjs
